lore: 中央庭的资源协调不再局限于一座城市或一颗行星。分散在不同星系的仓储、换装站与施工队采用共同的清单和交接标准，让已经集成的工程备料能够送到真正需要它的现场。
application: 登记一处异星系工程接收点，从常规联运接收端支付500能源，将一份已备妥的大型工程备料运抵当地。施工点可接续分段营建或舰体承载试验，无需搬动原常规接收端；原工程的研究、设施、费用和工期仍须满足。

registration.source: existing valid ordinary C11 receiving endpoint with B14 yard in another system
registration.cancellation: free, original owner even if occupied/disabled; only removes role, stock and existing work remain

dispatch.source: valid original-owner ordinary C11 receiver with one actual B14 pack
dispatch.target: unique valid engineering endpoint in a different system, with no B14 pack
dispatch.payment: guarded fixed deduction in effect; no native decision second fee
dispatch.result: move one acs_strategic_supply_reserved from source to destination immediately
dispatch.country_pack_limit: existing B14 national one-pack invariant retained
dispatch.native_selection: any_owned_colony / random_owned_colony with identical target predicate, filtered before mutation
dispatch.predicate_constraint: target predicate does not require source pack or pre-payment energy, so remains true after removal/payment

consumers.E09: original one national project, consume pack then prepare3 / assemble4 / commission2; original later costs
consumers.D13: original one national trial, consume pack then6 valid monthly; completed country knowledge retains ownership
consumers.B14_preparation: remains ordinary C11 receiver only; new endpoint cannot manufacture its own pack or bypass payment
consumers.capacity: E11 adds no second construction capacity; completed E09 still supplies its original +1
consumers.lifetime: local validity gates existing work; source may close after delivery; remote role removal pauses only dependent work

lifecycle.loss_of_control: no dispatch/work; stock and paid work retained
lifecycle.transfer_destroy: existing ACS clear removes remote role, stock and unfinished work; no inheritance/refund
lifecycle.stock_after_unregister: retained, can re-register to use or withdraw under existing B14 safe original-owner rule
lifecycle.refund: existing 1600minerals/800alloys once, transport energy never refunded

sections: 中央庭：资源调配、重建与公共治理
普通科技为神器研究提供工业与工程基础
sources.constraint: 以公共设施和交接标准表达跨星系工程协作；具体调度、费用和唯一端点均属Mod工程设计。

native_reference.reference: 既有4.5.2脚本文档和C11/E09/D13消费者

未校验引擎隐式岗位、修正、trait、outliner 图标；须以最新冷启动日志和游戏内显示验收。

validation.fixture_note: 正式作用域栈区分国家/星系/殖民地/行星；准备、交付和E09/D13流程均执行实际脚本。最后显式carrier核对后6项定向复查通过。
limitations: 场地建筑及研究为输入夹具，原生建筑施工、决议显示、巨构容量应用与存读档未验。
33项源码检查不是33次游戏测试；本轮未启动或操作游戏，也未复测旧运行流程。

runtime.priority: 阶段试玩仍优先D12；E11可并入一条物资/工程代表链，共用关键读档，不新增逐包强制试玩。

compatibility_updates.note: 标准费用保留；有效E12命运都市工业协调在付款时降低E09装配/试运行或E11运输费。来源失效恢复标准价，不补扣已付阶段；新路径运行未验。
